review: Kindly understand that I do not write these. A colleague showed me this site in June and I have said nothing about it to anybody except the matron, because the hours between two and four in the morning are not something one discusses. But there is a track on this album called "The Care Worker's Prayer" and I need whoever wrote it to know that it is correct. Not moving — correct. It does not ask God to make the ward easier and it does not thank Him for the privilege of service, which is the thing people write when they have never done it. It asks for the strength to be present at the exact moment somebody stops being frightened. That is the whole job. Mgema akisifiwa tembo hulitia maji — when the brewer is praised he waters the drink. Most worship about nursing is watered. This is not.
